Review Plausible Analytics?

Reviewers mostly see Plausible Analytics as a clean, fast, privacy-first replacement for Google Analytics that is easy to set up and good enough for personal sites, small products, and client work. People repeatedly praise its simple dashboard, bot filtering, cookie-banner removal, and smooth use with static sites, Next.js, and custom subdomains. A few makers also say, from building products like Harbor, that goals and custom properties are useful for tracking real signups. The main criticism is that reporting can feel basic, docs may be outdated, and support can be weak.

Their transparent business model and user privacy focus are a breath of fresh air in the web analytics industry. This approach has deeply inspired me and motivated me to seek ways to apply similar principles in my digital marketing studio.
